title: HYTKY Rentals
intro: HYTKY rents out DJ and PA equipment.
logistics: The equipment should be picked up and returned to our storage in Merihaka, Helsinki. The renter is generally responsible for all logistics related to moving the equipment and responsible for the condition of the equipment during the rental period. A rental agreement is signed upon pickup or electronically. HYTKY is a volunteer-run student organization, so please send your inquiries as early as possible.
priceNote: Prices below are daily rates (24h period). Additional days are 50% off.

items.name: Monitors only: 2x Alto TX310 speakers
items.description: For background music, speeches, and light amplification

items.name: Sub with monitors: 1x Sub (Electro-Voice ELX-118P) + 2x Monitors (Alto TX310)
items.description: Small parties where some bass is needed

items.name: Active PA with 1 Sub: 1x Sub (Electro-Voice ELX-118P) + 2x Top (Electro-Voice ZLX-15P)
items.description: Small to mid-size parties. Bass may be lacking if played at higher volumes.

items.name: Active PA: 2x Sub (Electro-Voice ELX-118P) + 2x Top (Electro-Voice ZLX-15P)
items.description: Mid-size parties (100-200 ppl), easy to use, fits in larger passenger cars

items.name: Passive PA: 4x Subs, 2x Void Tops (+ 6x IREX) + amplifiers
items.price: Ask separately, installation for an extra fee
items.description:
Heavier soundsystem.
Fits in a van.

cablesNote: The necessary cables and speaker stands are included with the equipment.
